articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, visual diagrams, and spoken instructions in a single inference pass. The model demonstrates significant improvements in long-context software engineering tasks, reportedly resolving 64% of SWE-bench Verified issues autonomously. This marks a shift from bolted-on modality adapters to a unified architecture trained end-to-end.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored a verified 92% on the IMO 2026 problem set using a novel chain-of-thought reinforcement learning approach combined with formal verification via Lean 4. The system's ability to generate human-readable proofs that are simultaneously machine-checkable represents a major step toward trustworthy AI-assisted mathematics. Researchers note the technique generalizes to formal verification of software correctness proofs.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Amazon Fulfillment Centers
articles.summary: Amazon confirmed a pilot program deploying approximately 1,000 Tesla Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots across three U.S. fulfillment centers for bin-picking and inventory transport tasks. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for zero-shot object manipulation, reducing the need for task-specific programming. Early reports indicate a 40% throughput improvement in mixed-SKU picking compared to existing robotic arm systems.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Handles Unstructured Outdoor Terrain with Real-Time Adaptive Gait Planning
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released a major software update for the electric Atlas platform enabling real-time terrain classification and adaptive gait generation using a sim-to-real transformer policy. The robot demonstrated reliable traversal of rocky hillsides, muddy slopes, and debris fields in live demonstrations at a DARPA evaluation event. The update brings Atlas closer to practical deployment in disaster response and construction site inspection scenarios.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Breakthrough Research on Mechanistic Interpretability of Billion-Parameter Models
articles.summary: Anthropic released a landmark paper demonstrating scalable mechanistic interpretability techniques that can identify and causally trace specific reasoning circuits in models exceeding 100 billion parameters. The research introduces 'circuit grafting,' a method allowing engineers to surgically edit model behaviors by transplanting verified reasoning subgraphs. The work has immediate implications for AI safety, enabling more precise detection of deceptive or misaligned reasoning patterns before deployment.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node, Promising 25% Efficiency Gains
articles.summary: TSMC announced the start of volume production on its N1.4 gate-all-around (GAA) transistor process at its Kaohsiung fab, with Apple and NVIDIA as anchor customers. The node delivers a 25% power efficiency improvement and 15% performance uplift over N2, critical for next-generation AI accelerators operating under tightening data center power constraints. Industry analysts expect the first consumer chips on N1.4 to ship in Q2 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Correction Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly announced sustained fault-tolerant operations on 32 logical qubits with error rates below 10⁻⁸ per gate cycle, crossing a critical threshold for practical quantum computation. The achievement uses Microsoft's topological error correction codes running on Quantinuum's latest trapped-ion hardware. While general-purpose quantum advantage remains years away, the milestone opens the door to near-term applications in materials simulation and cryptographic research.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing and On-Device Foundation Models
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C at an $18 billion valuation, with backing from Intel Capital, Samsung, and existing investor Microsoft. The funding will be used to build a dedicated humanoid robot manufacturing facility in Texas and to develop proprietary on-device vision-language-action models that reduce cloud dependency. The company plans to produce 10,000 units of its Figure 03 robot annually by late 2027 for logistics and light manufacturing verticals.
